extension_name.message: Sift: A Filter Toolbar for Gmail

extension_description.message: Filtre o Gmail por convites de calendário, tipo de anexo, notas de IA ou email normal.

label_toolbar.message: Barra de ferramentas de filtro de e-mail e calendário
label_toolbar.description: ARIA label for the main toolbar.

btn_cal.description: Button to show only calendar e-mails.

btn_attach.description: Button to show only e-mails with attachments.

btn_fav.description: Button to show only starred/favourite e-mails.

button_filter_images.description: Button to show only emails with image attachments.

button_filter_pdfs.description: Button to show only emails with PDF attachments.

button_filter_documents.description: Button to show only emails with document attachments.

button_filter_spreadsheets.description: Button to show only emails with spreadsheet attachments.

button_filter_presentations.description: Button to show only emails with presentation attachments.

page_title.description: Title for the extension's options page.

options_page_description.message: Configure as opções de filtragem e as preferências da barra de ferramentas para o Gmail.
options_page_description.description: A short summary of the options page.

options_debug_legend.description: Legend for the debug settings fieldset.

options_debug_label.message: Ativar o modo de depuração (realça as linhas filtradas a azul em vez de as ocultar)
options_debug_label.description: Label for the debug mode checkbox.

options_show_text_legend.description: Legend heading for button text options.

options_alignment_legend.description: Legend heading for toolbar layout options.

options_alignment_label.description: Label for the toolbar alignment control.

options_alignment_start.description: Option to align the toolbar buttons to the start.

options_alignment_center.description: Option to align the toolbar buttons to the centre.

options_show_favourites_label.description: Label for the option to display the Favourites filter button.

options_theme_label.description: Label for the theme selection control.

options_theme_system.description: Option to follow the operating system theme preference.

options_theme_light.description: Option to always use the light theme.

options_theme_dark.description: Option to always use the dark theme.

alt_calendar_event.description: The alt text for the calendar event icon in an email row.

filter_status_update.description: Announcement for screen readers when filter is updated. $1 is the filter mode (e.g., All Email, Mail Only)

extension_action_title.message: A barra de ferramentas de filtro de e-mail e calendário está incorporada nas páginas do Gmail
extension_action_title.description: The title of the extension's action button in the browser toolbar.

alt_starred.description: Alt text for the starred icon/tooltip

optionShowButtonText.message: Mostrar texto nos botões de filtro
optionShowButtonText.description: Label for the option to show or hide text on the filter buttons.

experimental_legend.description: Legend for experimental features section in options page.

experimental_description.message: As funcionalidades experimentais estão em testes ativos e podem mudar.
experimental_description.description: Description text explaining experimental features may not be fully localized.

btn_ai_notetakers.description: Button to show emails from AI services and transcription tools.

options_show_ai_notetakers.message: Mostrar botão de IA e transcrição
options_show_ai_notetakers.description: Checkbox label in options page to enable/disable AI & Transcription filter button.

btn_dev_notifications.description: Button to show emails from developer platforms like GitHub and GitLab.

options_show_dev_notifications.message: Mostrar botão de notificações de programador
options_show_dev_notifications.description: Checkbox label in options page to enable/disable Dev Notifications filter button.

options_status_saved.description: Status message shown on the options page after settings are saved.

options_status_save_error.message: Não foi possível guardar as definições. Tente novamente.
options_status_save_error.description: Status message shown on the options page when saving settings fails.

options_status_load_error.message: Não foi possível carregar as definições. Feche e reabra esta página para tentar novamente.
options_status_load_error.description: Status message shown on the options page when loading settings fails.

alt_has_attachment.description: Tooltip text Gmail uses for the attachment indicator. Should mirror Gmail's own localized 'Has attachment' tooltip so attachment detection works in this language.
